activation_requirements: Root first adopts independently reviewed complete source and protected workflow bodies at source commit S.

Original package export must bind an actual completed CI pull_request run/attempt for same-repository PR 1: API head S, actual tested/package build merge M, exported original before/after head M and tree T. Pin exact artifact ID, ZIP digest, export manifest SHA256, package_build_sha M and source_tree_sha T; do not relabel M as S. Checkout S is accepted only when its actual clean tree equals T and every original shipping hash still matches.

Prepare authorization commit R with one parent P. S must be an ancestor of P. Its entire delta is the one active request path; VM additionally requires the exact release receipt path. Disable Git rename detection when checking this delta.

Set all closed-schema fields using actual observed identities and hashes; request_id is a fresh 32-character lowercase hexadecimal identifier. R is not embedded in itself; request_parent_sha is P and expected_source_sha is S.
Push R to existing same-repository PR 1 branch codex/autofill-evaluation-hardening. Only synchronize events run this PR route. Missing, disabled, or stale requests perform no package work.
DOWNLOAD_ONLY resolves/downloads a candidate without installing archives, starting a VM or exercising the product. The resulting closure remains UNREVIEWED.

A VM request additionally needs an actual different review of complete immutable candidate closure and an exact committed RELEASE_ONE_BOUND_CAMPAIGN receipt, all subject/hash bindings, and root release. No such receipt or closure is supplied by this template.

workflow_dispatch remains a route after GitHub recognizes the workflow; the same committed request and exact dispatch input cross-checks remain mandatory. Rerun attempts greater than one are refused; prepare a new root request rather than retrying an actor.
authorship_limit: Same-repository opt-in records trusted root/repository-process intent. It does not cryptographically prove the human author or replace independent source/closure review.
